params.price: Price in wei. Use 0 for free.

checkBatch(address,string[]).notice: Check multiple behaviors for a user in one call (gas-efficient for UI).

getAllBehaviors().notice: Get all registered behavior keys and their prices.

isUnlocked(address,string).notice: Check if a user has unlocked a behavior.         Free behaviors (price = 0) always return true.

setPrice(string,uint256).notice: Set the unlock price for a behavior key.         Set to 0 to make a behavior free.

setPriceBatch(string[],uint256[]).notice: Batch-set prices for multiple behaviors at once.

unlock(string).notice: Pay to unlock a premium behavior for the caller's address.         If the behavior is free (price = 0), no payment needed — just call isUnlocked check.
